long_biography.plain_text:
Commercial-aircraft leasing became the focus of Jorge Luis Wolf's career after he qualified as a lawyer in South Florida. By the end of the 1990s, he was an officer of AirTrust Capital. He subsequently moved into fund management by co-founding Aviator Capital around pooled investment vehicles for used aircraft and engines.

At Aviator, Wolf combines investment and operating responsibilities. As principal, chief investment officer and chief executive, he directs portfolio decisions while helping structure leases, financing arrangements and joint ventures. He also serves as manager of Aviator investment managers and fund general partners across its pooled investment vehicles.
